summary: What's New Changelog Box, ClickGUI Update Pill, One-Click Cloud Releases

changes.title: What's New Changelog Box
changes.detail: Added an interactive frosted-glass modal box inside the ClickGUI that automatically opens after an update, displaying color-coded NEW, FIX, and IMP cards with smooth mouse-wheel scrolling.

changes.title: ClickGUI Update Pill
changes.detail: Added a top-right header pill in the ClickGUI showing "Update Ready | Apply & Close" when a new build is staged, or "What's New" to reopen release notes anytime.

changes.title: One-Click Cloud Releases
changes.detail: Added a GitHub Actions Build & Publish Release workflow that compiles, audits, releases, mirrors latest.json, and posts to Discord from the cloud.

changes.title: Toast Glyph & Badge Border Fix
changes.detail: Fixed the unsupported Unicode bullet character in the update banner subtitle and repaired the emerald icon badge border stacking.

changes.title: Anti-Downgrade Dev Guard
changes.detail: Embedded Build-Release and Build-Timestamp manifest metadata so local development builds are never overwritten by older releases.

changes.title: Duplicate Release Post Prevention
changes.detail: Added SHA-256 deduplication on release edits so editing release notes never double-posts to Discord.

changes.title: Atomic Windows Swapper
changes.detail: Upgraded the exit swapper to UTF-16LE Base64 -EncodedCommand with atomic same-directory rename, stealth %TEMP% marker cleanup, and orphan .tmp pruning.

changes.title: Pre-Publish JAR Sanity Audit
changes.detail: GitHub Actions now verifies ZIP integrity, fabric.mod.json, and ClumpsClient.class before publishing latest.json.
